headline: Hydrogen Stocks Splinter as Pure Plays Plunge and Incumbents Hold Ground
summary: The hydrogen sector splits as pure-play fuel cell stocks plunge despite strong earnings, while industrial gas giants like Linde and Air Products hold steady with solid profitability and moderate valuations.
